headword: {産学連携|さんがくれんけい}

definitions.explanation: Cooperative activities between industry (businesses) and academic institutions (universities, research labs), such as joint research, technology transfer, and sponsored programs.

examples.japanese: {産学連携|さんがくれんけい}で{新技術|しんぎじゅつ}を{開発|かいはつ}した。
examples.english: New technology was developed through industry-academia collaboration.

examples.japanese: {大学|だいがく}は{産学連携|さんがくれんけい}に{力|ちから}を{入|い}れている。
examples.english: The university is putting effort into industry-academia partnerships.

examples.japanese: {産学連携|さんがくれんけい}による{共同研究|きょうどうけんきゅう}が{増|ふ}えており、{実用化|じつようか}された{成果|せいか}も{出|で}ている。
examples.english: Joint research through industry-academia collaboration is increasing, and some results have been put into practical use.

notes:
USAGE:
A key concept in Japanese science and technology policy. Government initiatives actively promote 産学連携 to accelerate innovation and technology transfer from universities to industry.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {産学連携|さんがくれんけい}プロジェクト (industry-academia collaboration project)
- {産学連携|さんがくれんけい}を{推進|すいしん}する (to promote industry-academia collaboration)
- {産学官連携|さんがくかんれんけい} (industry-academia-government collaboration)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {産官学|さんかんがく}: industry-government-academia — the three-way version including government
